payload.title: Story similarity index and group locks (M)
payload.description:
An index of stories so that automations can find neighbours and coordinate cross-story decisions. Smallest first version: embeddings over in-flight and recently published stories plus a neighbourhood query; entities and clusters and group locks follow once the query is in use.

Scope:
- An index over published stories (within a configurable window) and in-flight stories: text embeddings plus shared entities and clusters.
- A "neighbourhood of story X" query returning nearest stories with overlap scores and the shared entities and clusters.
- Group locks: a soft lock on a set of stories while a cross-story decision is open. Per-story bots skip locked stories.

Acceptance criteria:
- A story entering or changing is indexed; stories outside the window are excluded.
- The neighbourhood query returns neighbours ranked by similarity with shared entities and clusters.
- A group lock can be taken and released on a set of stories, shows on each story, and per-story bots skip locked stories.
- Gherkin specs (narrative, complete) required.

Depends on the human review points story.
